name: Genetic Syndrome with Dandy-Walker Malformation as a Major Feature

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Dandy-Walker Malformation Genetic Syndrome Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of Dandy-Walker malformation confirmed by neuroimaging
Identification of pathogenic genetic variant associated with Dandy-Walker malformation
Developmental delay or intellectual disability consistent with syndrome
Presence of associated central nervous system anomalies (e.g., hydrocephalus, corpus callosum agenesis)
Characteristic craniofacial features such as macrocephaly or hypertelorism

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of Dandy-Walker malformation on imaging plus genetic confirmation of pathogenic variant and neurological impairment
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including neuroimaging and genetic testing.

pathognomonic.notes: Characterized by hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis, cystic dilatation of the fourth ventricle, and enlargement of the posterior fossa

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hydrocephalus secondary to fourth ventricle obstruction
searchTerms: fluid buildup in brain due to blockage
brain swelling caused by CSF blockage

pathognomonic.notes: Ranges from mild to severe intellectual disability

laboratory: Genetic testing identifying pathogenic variants in genes associated with Dandy-Walker malformation
imaging: MRI showing hypoplasia or agenesis of cerebellar vermis
Cystic dilatation of the fourth ventricle
genetic: Mutations in genes such as ZIC1, ZIC4, FOXC1, or other loci implicated in cerebellar development
other: Cardiac evaluation for associated congenital heart defects

distinguishingFeatures: Molar tooth sign on MRI instead of classic Dandy-Walker malformation
Enlarged cisterna magna without cerebellar vermis hypoplasia

redFlags: Rapidly progressive hydrocephalus causing increased intracranial pressure
references: Dandy-Walker Malformation: Clinical and Genetic Aspects. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases, 2023.
Genetic Basis of Dandy-Walker Malformation. American Journal of Medical Genetics, 2022.
Neuroimaging Features of Posterior Fossa Malformations. Radiology Clinics, 2021.
